# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is a fair, ethereal-appearing young woman with exquisite, pale-light hair.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)_

## Personality

Despite her ethereal appearance and habit of staring through windows, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)_

## Traits

- Mischievous  <sub>[v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)</sub>
- Humorous  <sub>[v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)</sub>

## History

Honora enrolled as a student at Regent's Academy in Port Marlow. She became part of a small group of contemplative, creative, and driven friends alongside Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)_
